information.description:
Hanako Arasaka's personal bodyguard, trained by Goro Takemura, the head of security for the Arasaka family. Oda is one of the deadliest cyberninjas in the world, with more custom gear and cyberware than most mercs will know about in their entire lives. If you ever face him, your best options are to run or pray for divine intervention to smite this demonic spirit. While he is extremely deadly, his honor often causes him to face opposition entirely alone, and he is thus susceptible to a theoretical overwhelming ambush or trap. It just better be a good trap with a lot of EMPs, because Oda will gut most foes like a fish in the blink of an eye.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Arasaka).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

Japanese culture loves smallness. Just look at the tiny, intricately crafted netsuke sculptures or the bonsai trees that fit into flowerpots. Shingen, the smart-machine-pistol made by Arasaka, is a love letter to Japan's passion for miniatures. It's hard to believe that the Shingen's stopping power, magazine size and numerous technical features fit into such a small body.

Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Subcompact SMG

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Efficient Autosear, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. If there are not 3 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine and deals 1d6 less damage (3d6). Using Autofire with this weapon expends 6 rounds instead of 10 [Efficient Autosear].

Range: Subcompact SMG
Pre-installed: Efficient Autosear, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

Now your iron won’t hit the dirt every time you drop it.

When the weapon is voluntarily dropped by the user, it is instead stowed without an Action. When the weapon is knocked out of the user’s hands — such as from an Aimed Shot or Critical Injury — it does not fall to the ground and remains hanging at their side. It then requires an Action to be readied before it can be drawn again.

When attempting to Grab a Sling-equipped weapon from its wielder/holder, the attacker suffers a -2 penalty to their Check to do so. While installed, the weapon is no longer Concealable.

Attachment slots: 0

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee • Range: Melee

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: None • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon’s second attack in a Round against the same target deals 1d6 extra damage (4d6), as long as the first attack hits. When performing an Ambush Attack from stealth, this weapon provides an additional +1 bonus to the Attack Check and its first Attack in that Round deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6) if successful.

If the user has active FBC Chameleon Coating and/or Optical Camo and is rolling for damage with this weapon, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries. Whenever this weapon’s user is actively using FBC Chameleon Coating or Optical Camo and has moved at least 2m/yds (1 square) this Turn, they can make a Leaping Strike attack that sends the user 4m/yds (2 squares) forward to attack a target with fierce speed. This takes up half of the weapon’s ROF 2, does not consume MOVE, and deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6) if successful.

Whenever this weapon’s user has active Speedware and spends at least one LUCK on an Attack with this weapon, they add an additional +1 to their Check.

Fabrication: N/A (Cannot be Fabricated. Must be gifted or scavenged from Sandayu Oda. So, good luck with that)
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: N/A

The cutting-edge helm of Sandayu Oda, Hanako Arasaka’s personal bodyguard and one of the most dangerous people alive today. Oda differs from his master’s (Goro Takemura) preference for discretion, and fully embodies the cyberninja life. As part of this, Oda used his effectively limitless security budget to provide himself gear unlike anything else in the world. This ‘Kagami’ helmet is actually the first Neo-Kabuto, with the rest being patterned off Oda’s designs. If you ever see this helm’s blood-red holographic Oni mask staring back at you from the shadows, run. Faster than you’ve ever ran in your likely soon-to-expire life.

Iconic SP 13 Head Armor with no Armor Penalty. All ablation this armor would suffer is reduced by 1 (Minimum 0). Comes with built-in TUp (+1 Slot) Smart Glasses (w/ Anti-Dazzle, Image Enhance, and Targeting Scope). While worn by a user with Melee Weapon Skill Level 7 or higher and Evasion Skill Level 7 or higher, or Combat Awareness Rank 6 or higher, this helmet’s cutting-edge software provides a +1 bonus to all Melee Weapon (+2 for Aimed Shots) and Evasion Skill Checks. Anyone attempting to target this helmet’s wearer with Smart or Improved Smart Ammunition suffers a -2 penalty to their Attack Check. After this armor spends 10 minutes not losing any SP, it completely repairs itself to SP 13.

Cost: Super Luxury (Iconic; Fabrication: N/A)
Covers: Head
SP: 13
Armor Penalty: none

Foundry notes:

  • The +1s are automated while equipped; add the extra point on Aimed Shots by hand, and disable the effect if you don't qualify.
